places.name: Plane Spotting at Mai Khao Beach
places.reason: Duplicate: the same id is already in the must-see list (flagged by the original researcher), and this famous spot is not a hidden gem. Checked for the must-see copy: open beach, watching free, 20 THB motorbike from the car park (Phuket 101, 6 Aug 2026), no 2025-2026 ban found. Coords OK: OSM node 8.11179, 98.30185 plus two Commons geotags within 170 m, about 160 m west of the runway 09 threshold (8.11199, 98.3033). Fix there: in January planes usually land over the sea; the 'December to June' range is doubtful, because the wind usually turns westerly from about May.

places.name: Rawai Seafood Market (buy and they cook)
places.reason: Duplicate of 'rawai-seafood-market' in the must-see list. It is the same place (Google pin 7.77574, 98.32892; both items are within 20 m of it) with the same Phuket 101 source. Re-checked facts for the kept item: operating (Google 4.4 from 4,717 reviews); stalls 09:00-21:00 on Google, 11:00-21:00 on Phuket 101; the restaurants that cook are open daily (Mook Manee 11:30-22:00, Khun Pha 11:00-22:00). Phuket 101 says the tour buses have already left by 19:00. Quieter option: Salaloy Seafood, 350 m west, closed on Thursdays.

hotels.name: See Sea Backpackers
hotels.reason: No booking channel works for Jan 2027. The hostel's own site (seeseabackpackers.com) shows a Wix 404. Its Hostelworld page (property 312348) and the Hostelworld API both return 404, so it has been delisted. Its Kayak page also returns 404, and it does not appear in Booking.com search, while the other Phangan hotels do. Google Hotels says 'Contact this property' and shows no rate for any date from Oct 2026 to Jan 2027. Its Google Maps listing is still up (newest reviews about 3 months old), so it may take walk-ins only, but it cannot be booked and is too risky to recommend. One more error: it is about 150 m from the Ban Tai shore by OSM paths, not the 900 m the item said.

appsCorrections.source: https://phanganlife.com/taxis-on-koh-phangan/ ; https://apps.apple.com/app/id1632709343

appsCorrections.claim: Thailand Tourist Police app is 'must'.
appsCorrections.correction: Make it 'useful'. You can call 1155 without the app. The app has low ratings: 2.3 of 5 on the US App Store and 1.7 on the UK store, from only 6 ratings each (Oct 2026). Keep 'Thai emergency numbers' as 'must'.
appsCorrections.source: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6479636779 ; https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/id6479636779

appsCorrections.claim: Bangkok Airways app is 'must'; it 'also shows where the airline's lounges are'.
appsCorrections.correction: Make it 'useful'. The lounge part is right: the app has a 'Lounge location' section. Online check-in works on the website and in the app, from 24 hours to 1 hour before the flight. Add a tip: the Boutique Lounge is free for all Bangkok Airways passengers, also economy. At Phuket it is in the domestic terminal, 2nd floor, near Gate 4, open 05:30-21:30 (Bangkok Airways, Nov 2025).
appsCorrections.source: https://blog.bangkokair.com/en/bangkok-airways-boutique-lounge/ ; https://blog.bangkokair.com/en/how-to-check-in-bangkok-airways/ ; https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id781290048

appsCorrections.claim: Wise and Revolut: 'Cash works at any Thai bank ATM', with no word on the ATM fee.
appsCorrections.correction: Add: Thai ATMs charge their own fee for each withdrawal with a foreign card. 2026 guides give 220 or 250 baht per withdrawal, and some machines charge more. Wise and Revolut do not pay it back. Take out bigger amounts less often. If the screen offers your home currency, choose baht.
appsCorrections.source: https://destinationthailand.io/money-in-thailand-atms-cards-fees/ ; https://thaibudgetplanner.com/news/2026-08-04-thailand-atm-fees-guide

appsCorrections.claim: myAIS and True tourist SIM items say nothing about how to register the SIM.
appsCorrections.correction: Add: since 16 May 2026, a foreigner must register a Thai SIM in person at a branch or authorized dealer, mainly with a passport. The limit is 3 SIMs per person per provider (NBTC rule). Bring your passport to the AIS or True counter at Phuket airport.
appsCorrections.source: https://www.tilleke.com/insights/thailand-tightens-telecom-registration-data-and-ip-address-rules-to-combat-tech-crime

appsCorrections.claim: TrueMoney: 'A foreigner can register with a passport and pay at 7-Eleven, shops and many QR codes.'
appsCorrections.correction: For foreigners, sign-up needs a Thai mobile number for the SMS code, then a passport scan and a live selfie. Approval can take 1 to 3 business days, and some travellers fail the check. Do not count on it for this trip.
appsCorrections.source: https://wise.com/en-th/blog/truemoney-wallet-guide ; https://thethaiger.com/guides/best-of/lifestyle/how-to-go-cashless-at-7-11-thailand

appsCorrections.claim: Overall: 13 'must' entries (12 different apps) is too many.
appsCorrections.correction: Merge the duplicates and move the Tourist Police app and the Bangkok Airways app to 'useful'. The 'must' list is then: Grab, Google Maps, Google Translate, Wise, LINE, WhatsApp, Thai emergency numbers, Lomprayah (book ahead, no app), DICE, Megatix, and the new TDAC. That is 11.
